targets.approach: The Faces is a steep, roofed granite prow above Bennett Lake near Carcross. Park at the lower mountain-bike lot on Montana Mountain Road, walk or bike the road a short way and take the Fox trail, then turn right downhill past a few berms toward the railway track and follow Wayne's World to where you leave the bikes. No trailhead marker or established path exists from there: head straight up the hill south to an old moraine from which the cliff is clearly visible, then bushwhack uphill as the angle steepens, keeping the cliff in view. Contour below the mossy slabs to a steep gully that leads directly to the base of The Surprise. Carry navigation. Le Coin is on the climber's right of the lowest section of the wall.
targets.descent_text: A bolted rappel line runs down from the top of the Pry Me climbs.
targets.name: Le Coin
